name: screenshot-game-view
description: Captures the Unity Editor Game View. Metadata: pngWidth/pngHeight (PNG, top-left origin), screenWidth/screenHeight (the Screen space clicks use, bottom-left). To click a spot you see, pass its 0..1 PNG position to ui-runtime-click/drag/probe with space:"screenshot" (the tool Y-flips and scales). If pixelMappingReliable:false is present the view is letterboxed — target by path/instanceId (ui-control-find) instead.

maxDimension.description: Maximum output width or height. Defaults to 960 to avoid oversized images. Raise for a higher-resolution capture.

savePath.description: Optional path to also write the resulting PNG to disk. Accepts an absolute path (e.g. C:/Shots/view.png) or a path relative to the Unity project folder (e.g. ./Temp/view.png). Parent folders are created as needed.
